key_insight: A symmetry-aware templating framework can rapidly build and compare low- and high-symmetry ABO3 perovskite structures, making distortion effects on properties more tractable.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical workflow for screening perovskite compositions and structural distortions without relying on prohibitively large brute-force supercell searches.
method: Use symmetry-constrained templates to generate candidate low- and high-symmetry structures.
Use unconstrained supercell templates to capture composition-dependent octahedral tilts and B-site displacements.
Test the workflow on 15 representative compositions to map links between composition, cell geometry, and distortion patterns.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic analysis of 15 representative compositions and uses the resulting structure-property trends to propose a rapid, low-cost exploration protocol.
watch_item: The framework may still miss rare or highly complex distortion modes if the chosen templates and supercell sizes are not sufficiently exhaustive.
paper_title: Mapping the influence of symmetry breaking in structure-property relationships of ABO$_3$ perovskites
